test_method.procedure_description: Conventional three-electrode cell with saturated calomel reference; one hour at open circuit, anodic scan at 0.1 mV/s, reverse at 0.05 mA. These Ep results arise from the anodic scans; the separate artificial-pit step/hold protocol is not assigned to them.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Ep at anodic current density two orders of magnitude above the passive current density.

experiments.result_note: Reported at the 99% confidence level; Ep determined by anodic current density two orders of magnitude above passive current. The bracketed Al87Ni8.7Y4.3 values occur only in the Er row; no additional Ep value is inferred for that alloy.
